mainEntity.name: How can a medical practice measure the success of its AEO efforts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Measuring AEO success involves tracking several metrics. Key performance indicators include increased organic traffic, especially from non-branded searches, a higher number of featured snippet appearances, improved visibility in 'People Also Ask' sections, and increased click-through rates from these direct answer boxes. Monitoring specific keyword rankings for question-based queries and analyzing user engagement with optimized content can also provide insights. Ultimately, success is tied to improved patient inquiries and appointments resulting from enhanced online visibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Success in AEO for a medical practice is measured by increased organic traffic, higher featured snippet appearances, better visibility in 'People Also Ask,' improved click-through rates, and ultimately, more patient inquiries.
